mapper.select: SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = o.create_by AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND o.create_by IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.create_by ORDER BY count DESC, MIN(o.create_time) ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.owner_user = #{username} AND l.status IN (1, 2) AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1, 2) AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) ) AND l.owner_user IN #{u}

SELECT base.owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN base.create_time >= #{start} AND base.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_count, SUM(CASE WHEN base.status = 3 AND base.create_time >= #{start} AND base.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.last_follow_time >= #{start} AND base.last_follow_time < #{end} THEN base.id END) AS followed_count, COALESCE(rec.cnt, 0) AS recycle_count FROM sale_lead base LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = base.owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.owner_user AS owner_user, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_user IN #{x} AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )
GROUP BY l.owner_user ) rec ON rec.owner_user = base.owner_user WHERE base.deleted = 0 AND base.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND base.owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY base.owner_user, rec.cnt ORDER BY new_count DESC, base.owner_user ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user = #{username} AND customer_type = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user = #{username} AND customer_type = 1 AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= #{dayStart} AND next_follow_time < #{dayEnd}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM customer_info c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_user = #{username} AND c.customer_type = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM customer_info c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_user = #{username} AND c.customer_type = 1 AND c.create_time >= #{start} AND c.create_time < #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user = #{username} AND customer_type = 1 AND last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= #{start} AND last_follow_time < #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user = #{username} AND customer_type = 1 AND status NOT IN (3, 4) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_type = 1 AND status NOT IN (3, 4) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) ) AND owner_user IN #{u}

SELECT c.owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.create_time >= #{start} AND c.create_time < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.create_time >= #{start} AND c.create_time < #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'PAID' AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deal_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.last_follow_time >= #{start} AND c.last_follow_time < #{end} THEN c.id END) AS followed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status NOT IN (3,4) AND ( (c.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND c.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND c.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (c.last_follow_time IS NULL AND c.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND c.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recycle_count FROM customer_info c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = c.owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.customer_type = 1 AND c.owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY c.owner_user ORDER BY new_count DESC, c.owner_user ASC
